records.issue_text: UsersResource.java:451: Setting UserModel.GROUPS restricts searches to permitted groups, excluding individually authorized users outside those groups before permission evaluation; searches must include users authorized individually or through group membership.
records.rationale: The finding describes a real issue in the diff. Looking at UsersResource.java lines 448-453, the code now unconditionally sets UserModel.GROUPS session attribute when groupIds is not empty, regardless of whether the user has canView() permission. Previously (lines 448-454 in the old code), this was only done when `!auth.users().canView()`. The new code also removes the `.filter(usersEvaluator::canView)` call from the stream (line 456 old vs line 453 new).
